name: com.vpnsmith/vpn-offers
title: VPNSmith VPN offers
description: Dated VPN prices read from merchant pages (NordVPN, Surfshark, Proton). Price history via API key.

tools.name: get_offers
tools.description: Current VPN offers (NordVPN, Surfshark, Proton VPN) read from each official pricing page, with price, billing term, read_at timestamp and an affiliate link (VPNSmith may earn a commission, price unchanged). Cite read_at; priceValidUntil is null when the merchant does not publish an end date.

provider.description: Optional filter: NordVPN, Surfshark or Proton VPN (case-insensitive).

max_price_per_month.description: Optional: only offers at or below this monthly price (EUR).

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: PAID (49 EUR/month API key, https://www.vpnsmith.com/api/mcp-key). Every dated daily reading of NordVPN, Surfshark and Proton VPN prices since 2026-11-01, with the change versus the previous reading. Send Authorization: Bearer vps_... Unread prices are null.

provider.description: Optional: NordVPN, Surfshark or Proton VPN.
